# llms.txt — AI discoverability for sanyi.dev

> Sanyi Diriba's personal portfolio — developer, founder, and tech content creator.

## About

Sanyi Diriba is a 16-year-old developer and founder from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. He builds products like Shiplog and YScroll, creates tech content for a 40K+ audience, and works with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sanyi.dev): Portfolio homepage with projects, stack, work experience, achievements, and social links.
- [Projects](https://sanyi.dev/projects): Products and apps — Shiplog, YScroll, AI Study Assistant, Go2Code, and more.
- [Videos](https://sanyi.dev/videos): Long-form YouTube videos about development, startups, and building in public.
- [Activity](https://sanyi.dev/activity): Recent posts from X and LinkedIn.
- [Achievements](https://sanyi.dev/achievements): Hackathon wins, certifications, and milestones.

## Key Projects

- [Shiplog](https://sanyi.dev/projects): Changelog platform for modern teams — automated release notes.
- [YScroll](https://yscroll.xyz): App and browser extension to reduce time spent on short-form content.
- [Go2Code](https://go2cod.com): Non-profit tech education platform co-founded by Sanyi.
- [AI Study Assistant](https://sanyi.dev/projects): AI-powered study notes, quizzes, and flashcards.

## Technical Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3
Backend: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Express, REST & HTTP
Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma
Tools: Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Figma, VS Code, Cursor
